proposed_from.topic: Closed-form sharp binary frontier under longitudinal product sensitivity ratios. Observe positive binary O=(A0,A1,L1,Y) with degenerate baseline, target mu11=E[Y(1,1)], fixed interior margin eta, and Tan product ratios lambda1, lambda0L, lambda0Y bounded by finite G,B,C. Impose exactly Tan Lemma 7's cellwise normalization constraints and use Lemma 8's compatible-law objective. Prove both sharp endpoints are attained and equal explicit evaluations of at most 64 rational branches each after reducing the ratios to binary success probabilities and one L1 reweighting. Prove complete necessary-and-sufficient observable conditions for equality versus strictness of both Proposition-3 conservative endpoints, including sensitivity-free faces and active ties. Construct multinomial plug-in confidence sets with uniform asymptotic coverage for the entire sharp interval over the eta-interior class using an all-branch Gaussian-multiplier envelope. Credit Tan (Biometrika 2025) for the product model, exact compatibility, generic sharp optimization, conservative bounds, and sensitivity-free exact faces; credit Bonvini et al. for longitudinal MSM sensitivity. Dickerman et al.'s repeated-strategy metformin target-trial analysis is the consumer for the absolute sustained-metformin cancer risk; no contrast or sign-breakdown claim is made. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: All ten ratio cells reduce to r_l=e_l p_l+(1-e_l)U_G(p_l), t_l=U_B(r_l), and one endpoint L1 reweighting, yielding at most 64 rational branches and attaining full-data laws. The supplied witness reproduces [0.3625,0.6375]. For active covariate sensitivity Tan v1 is strictly loose; for G,B>1 v2 is exact iff (p_l-1/(G+1))(r_l-1/(B+1))>=0 in both strata, with ties included. A strict interior witness gives sharp 61/80, v1 25/32, and v2 49/64; 1,000 random exact comparisons found no criterion failure. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove uniform Gaussian-multiplier quantile approximation over all branch gradients, including redundant or zero-variance coordinates, and the uniform quadratic remainder bound across branch changes; independently verify both equality-chain proofs against the final published Proposition 3. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the published binary check-loss programs and certify the rational strictness witness 61/80 versus 25/32 and 49/64; a different shared-threshold specification requires re-deriving the strictness theorem before proceeding. seed_details.anchor_location: Published Lemmas 7--8, equations (32)--(38), and the proof of Lemma 7; Introduction and final discussion were also read.
seed_details.opportunity: Reduce the positive binary specialization of Tan's exact compatible-law program to the binary probability maps \(D_K\) and \(U_K\), and prove that each endpoint is an evaluation of no more than \(64\) rational branches with an attaining full-data law.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Tan's optimization over three ratio functions by the success probabilities \(s_\ell=p_\ell\lambda_1(\ell,1)\), \(t_\ell=r_\ell\lambda_{0Y}(\ell,1)\), and \(h=q\lambda_{0L}(0)\); the normalization constraints then become intervals rather than functional constraints.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\{\text{binary product sensitivity},\text{closed-form sharp frontier}\}\) returned Tan's generic program but no finite branch reduction.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Tan because binary likelihood-ratio boxes always optimize at their corners.
seed_details.rebuttal: The corners remain coupled by two conditional normalizations and the covariate reweighting; completeness requires a bijective reduction, exhaustive branch domains, interval filling, and a full-data lift.
seed_details.burned_reason: The sole developed angle was mathematically sound after source-fidelity repair but capped at subfield and not salvageable to field within scope.

seed_details.anchor_location: Published Proposition 3 and Corollary 1, together with the two Jensen and minimax relaxation chains in the supplementary proof; Introduction and final discussion were also read.
seed_details.opportunity: Give observable necessary-and-sufficient conditions, including ties and every sensitivity-free face, under which each of Tan's two conservative binary endpoints equals the sharp endpoint.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Reverse every inequality in the proof of Proposition 3: equality in the first component becomes equality in a binary Jensen step, while equality in the second becomes intersection of two binary check-loss threshold sets.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for the pair \(\{\text{Tan Proposition 3},\text{equality or strictness}\}\) found only the published sufficient exact faces, not an observable iff frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Corollary 1 because the only exact cases are the three sensitivity-free faces.
seed_details.rebuttal: The binary shared-threshold condition yields additional active-sensitivity equality regions, and its complement yields a relatively open strictness region; neither direction appears in Corollary 1.

seed_details.anchor_location: The final discussion explicitly leaves estimation from sample data open; Lemma 8 supplies the population functional whose nonregular sample analogue is required.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a multinomial plug-in confidence set that covers the complete sharp interval uniformly over an \(\eta\)-interior class, including active ties, redundant branches, singular covariance, and zero-variance branch coordinates.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Linearize all rational branch extensions before applying the endpoint minimum or maximum, and calibrate the maximum of all branch scores instead of estimating an active set.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination pair \(\{\text{finite min/max sharp bound},\text{all-branch Gaussian multiplier}\}\) is not covered by Zhang and Zhao's smooth sensitivity-curve bands or Fang and Santos's pointwise directional bootstrap.
seed_details.red_team: Routine from a finite-dimensional delta method because there are only \(128\) branches.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform coverage at branch ties is not supplied by an ordinary delta method; the proof must control branch-switch remainders and multiplier quantiles uniformly under singular and partly degenerate score vectors.

seed_details.anchor_location: Published Lemmas 7--8 and Proposition 3, with Dorn and Guo's Theorem 1 and threshold-weight construction used as the adjacent method exemplar.
seed_details.opportunity: Unify the finite sharp frontier, the complete conservative-equality atlas, and uniform inference into one binary product-sensitivity result for the absolute sustained-strategy risk.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Begin with the exact compatibility fiber rather than either conservative relaxation, and preserve every branch through the inference step.
seed_details.destination_search: No located article jointly supplies closed-form product-model endpoints, an iff relaxation frontier, and confidence sets for the whole nonregular interval.
seed_details.red_team: This is three small binary exercises bundled into a paper.
seed_details.rebuttal: The common compatibility geometry is load-bearing in all three results: it yields the finite frontier, identifies exactly which Proposition 3 inequalities lose information, and supplies the fixed branch family needed for honest inference.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, Theorem 1, Proposition 1, and the discussion of strict conservatism of relaxed balancing bounds were read.
seed_details.opportunity: Derive a quantitative lower bound for Tan's conservative gap on observable regions separated from all binary threshold surfaces.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn strict Jensen and threshold incompatibility into a modulus using the distance of \(p_\ell\) and \(r_\ell^\pm\) from their critical probabilities.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination pair \(\{\text{longitudinal product ratios},\text{uniform strict-gap modulus}\}\) was unoccupied in the targeted scan.
seed_details.red_team: A compactness corollary of the iff theorem gives the gap immediately.
seed_details.rebuttal: A named closed-form modulus would require more than compactness, but its marginal value is below the iff characterization.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, the finite maximum example, Theorem 3.2, and the local-analysis discussion were read.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the exact directional limit law of each sharp endpoint at every active branch face and give a derivative-aware pointwise bootstrap.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Compute the directional derivative as the extremum of gradients over the population contact set instead of differentiating the empirically selected branch.
seed_details.destination_search: The pair \(\{\text{Tan product endpoint},\text{directional derivative}\}\) was not located.
seed_details.red_team: A direct corollary of Fang and Santos for a finite min/max map.
seed_details.rebuttal: The derivative formula is routine once the branch representation is known, so this seed is retained only as an inference lemma and not as the kernel.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and Main Result 2 on multiplier approximation for maxima were read, together with the application discussion.
seed_details.opportunity: Push an exact multinomial confidence region through all rational branches to obtain finite-sample coverage of the sharp interval.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Invert a simultaneous multinomial cell-probability test before evaluating the endpoint map.
seed_details.destination_search: Exact multinomial inversion is available generically, but no source was found that gives a tractable product-sensitivity image with competitive width.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate and extremely conservative from any simultaneous confidence region for seven multinomial cells.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds because no new sharp inversion or width guarantee is evident.

seed_details.anchor_location: The finite maximum example and the estimated directional derivative construction with a shrinking contact threshold were read.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a contact-set-adaptive multiplier interval that is uniformly honest at ties and strictly shorter than the all-branch envelope away from ties.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Screen branch values within a shrinking deterministic tolerance before taking the multiplier maximum, following the estimated directional derivative rather than the full branch set.
seed_details.destination_search: Firpo, Galvao, and Parker treat optimized values uniformly, but the targeted scan found no adaptation theorem for this singular finite rational frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Standard generalized moment selection already gives the result.
seed_details.rebuttal: Uniform two-endpoint coverage with moving rational branch faces and singular score covariance requires a frontier-specific contact-set and anti-concentration argument; it remains an open-ended extension.

seed_details.anchor_location: Published Proposition 6 and Corollary 2 on the general \(K\)-period product model were read after the two-period construction.
seed_details.opportunity: Represent a binary \(K\)-period sharp product frontier by a finite-state recursion rather than a generic coupled optimization.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Propagate binary success-probability intervals backward through every counterfactual covariate rather than applying the two-period scalar reweighting once.
seed_details.destination_search: The targeted search found Tan's recursive conservative bounds but no sharp finite-state product recursion.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection does not establish routine feasibility because compatibility introduces shared counterfactual histories, but the absence of a verified reverse lift makes this seed too risky for the present version.
